en.title: Minimum Boys Next to Girls
en.description:
Place the minimum number of boys in empty seats so that every girl has at least one directly adjacent seat occupied by a boy.

This site's standard input/output format and additional bounds are as described in this problem.
en.input: One line containing a string s (1≤|s|≤2×10^5) consisting only of G and -.
en.output: Output the minimum number of boys; output -1 if it is impossible.
en.explanation: Process uncovered girls from left to right. Prefer placing a boy in the empty seat to her right, which can also cover a following adjacent girl; if that seat is unavailable, try the left one. Brute-forcing all placement subsets serves as an independent oracle.
